causesAndRepairs.cause: Acyclic wrappers and simple recursive tails lost their cheaper specialized SQL plans.
causesAndRepairs.repair: Choose fusion for rich reusable control, and specialized walks for thin wrappers or independently cyclic descendants.

causesAndRepairs.cause: Local memo and depth bookkeeping activated unnecessary global peak tracking.
causesAndRepairs.repair: Track local predicate peaks and activate global tracking only for actual memo writers.

causesAndRepairs.cause: Ancestor demands repeated an expensive, total predicate helper.
causesAndRepairs.repair: Use a local completed-answer memo transaction under a proof excluding captures, utilities, and typed callbacks.

causesAndRepairs.cause: Finite instruction tables and Search SQL templates were duplicated under root demand.
causesAndRepairs.repair: Publish immutable code tables at statement scope and share the Search handler when the large plan requires it.

causesAndRepairs.cause: Recursive parsing initialized child SQL before a successful parse required it.
causesAndRepairs.repair: Defer expensive child setup for proved literal roots and preserve the cheaper existing plan for broader roots.

resourceContract.orderedGrammars: Source and finite IR and emitted operators <= 256; typed return cells <= 128
